prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1017; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows scraping and paint transfer along the right rear quarter panel, with a cracked tail lamp housing and a bent rear bumper bracket. The pattern and height of the marks are consistent with the reported sideswipe during a lane change, and nothing observed suggests earlier damage to this area. Labor hours for panel straightening, refinishing and lamp replacement are in line with the repairs described. Two similar charges posted on the same day are still under review and have not been confirmed. Repair plan: remove and replace the tail lamp assembly, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and replace the bumper bracket, pending final sign-off on the flagged charges.
